title: High Rise Hotel and Waterparks
content: I dream of a high rise hotel and waterparks often. I always feel at peace and happy in these dreams. I’m often with family or people I knew from childhood. The hotel is huge and I’m always wanting to go to the top floor. I’ve been here with my niece (she’s 6 and I haven’t talked to her about this) and we look out over the city. I’ve seen a circus in the lobby of the hotel, and a big parade. I visit water parks frequently also. I’m usually on an inner tube just floating along. Once I was on a more high-powered ride at the water park. It seemed like a water roller coaster, if you can imagine it. Nothing extreme but definitely some drops and water pressure powering you along faster. I’m so interested in this and I have always thought I was going to another dimension. With as many other people that seem to go to these same places, maybe I’ve been right all along
